finalSayRing.line: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
🕯️ Theo is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
🕯️ Theo Lindqvist is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
"Theo's gone." Caleb looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Theo." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Stan blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
📖 LEARNED: Tainted Bait (Level 1). Your bait is tainted — traps catch 50% more. (The poison’s in the bait, not your hands. Mostly.)
📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
📖 The Codex turns a page: Theo Lindqvist, 125 days. The mantle passes to Stan Kowalski.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Stan Kowalski, 47 — an exterminator. His hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room.
◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
You knew Theo — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting him, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
At the grave, Arnold, Omar, Caleb and 2 more speak for Stan — "Theo trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
The fire knew Stan before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
"Can we talk?" Caleb sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to Caleb.)
🌿 Omar returns from foraging the wilds: +218 kcal to the pantry — the shelves are full, so 217 kcal is eaten at the fire instead.
🪤 Caleb is back from the snares: +352 kcal to the pantry.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)
Travel 1 tile to grove.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to meadow.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
It followed you. The Ugly Beast is here.
A sturdy stick (crafting material).
You work the patch with practiced hands: 16× Hickory Nuts, 9× White Oak Acorns, 7× American Persimmon (910 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
(The snare wire becomes the snare — improvised, 2 uses.)
You set a Snare here. Check it tomorrow.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You keep a day's food (910 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
You walk back into Haven. 50 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
You clear a dead bed. Sow fresh seed to start a new crop. (40 kcal.)
You sow American Persimmon: 730 days to first harvest. Later harvests need 60 days of regrowth. Tend daily; garden magic can accelerate growth. (2 units sown.)
📋 Arnold — 🎣 Fish. Arnold nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Jorge — 🍲 Cook. (a natural — good pick) Jorge nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
You eat American Persimmon (650 kcal).
Dawn's an hour off — too late for real sleep. Rest a while instead, or wait for morning.
🪨 Arnold pries 2 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (151 stone now.)
🍲 Jorge cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
📨 Word came: a quiet hunter of Thornfield wants to join Haven. "My village is gone. Yours isn't. That's the whole of it." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
The village debates a quiet hunter. Warm, mostly. "One more pair of hands." (75% for.)
📨 The village didn't wait for you. a quiet hunter was vouched for around the fire — they're walking.
Accepted. a quiet hunter is walking. They'll reach Haven in a few days — membership starts when they arrive, but the village already counts them.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +2302 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Rachid came back with 635 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 318 kcal in, 317 kcal eaten at the fire.
Ursula and Caleb lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Omar takes one look at the full shelves and unshoulders the pack. "Leave the wild standing. Hauling water for the cistern."
🍽️ Arnold watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."
🪤 TRAP: Your Snare 1 tile east caught a Gray Squirrel! — set it, waited, and the old way worked. About 350 kcal on the bone — clean it quickly (knife). It rots fast.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
(Bargain — owe the System a favor — or don't.)
— DAY 126 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
💬 Omar says: "The voice said 'north.' Just... north. I don't know what it means."
🔥 Omar says it at the fire, not quite looking at Rachid: “Your trade story doesn’t add up. Someone had to say it.” The fire goes quiet in the way it does when someone’s decided to be brave.

Rachid is quiet for a long moment. Then, all in a rush: “Fine. It’s true. Not therapist — nurse. I lied because the truth felt small.” The admission hangs there, and the village — to its credit — doesn’t pounce.
Three more names. The list is getting heavy. Strangers send you their truths now — sealed, hopeful, terrified.
Rachid Tazi reads the sky: rain tomorrow, cold.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Arnold — 💧 Fetch water. Arnold nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
Arnold left 1 bark strip by the stash. No announcement. That's how it works here.
🌱 Jorge waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Jorge checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~8 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Jorge hauls back 6 wood. The pile grows. (483 logs now.)
💧 Arnold returns with 13L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Arnold telling Ursula about you. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
Ursula heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
Jorge heads out to check the snares. "Wire doesn't lie."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.

You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)

💛 You hold Bus Schedule. The 42. 6:14, 6:44, 7:14 — never late, even the last week, when the driver ran an empty bus through an empty city because the schedule said so. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. Something moves out there — Buffering.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 11× Muscadine Grapes (990 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
The Buffering stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
You keep a day's food (990 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.

Caleb will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
📋 Arnold — 🎣 Fish. Arnold nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Jorge — 🍲 Cook. (a natural — good pick) Jorge nods eagerly. They'll report back by next part.
They're burying their speaker — grain can wait a week; grief can't. Tending resumes when the mourning lifts.

You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
💧 Arnold eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the wood run instead.
🪵 Arnold hauls back 11 wood. The pile grows. (494 logs now.)
🍲 Jorge cooked for the haven — meals stretched.
🪤 Ursula is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
🪤 Jorge is back. "Snares were empty. They'll keep."
🪤 Jorge is back from the pit line: White-tailed Deer in the pit — +952 kcal to the pantry.
💬 Caleb has Omar's ear — quiet talk, the kind that doesn't need an audience.
— NIGHT — Camp. Rest — or risk the dark.
Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
Riders from Emberhold: something's at THEIR door now. They can't spare anyone — and they wanted Haven to know first.
You catch fragments by the fire — Arnold telling Rachid about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Omar telling Ursula about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
🌾 Tribute wagons from Emberhold turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🌾 Tribute wagons from Stonebridge turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🌾 Tribute wagons from Thornfield turn at the gate — our shelves are full past tomorrow. "Eat well," we send back. "That IS your tribute this week." (Trust +1.)
🧳 Word from Emberhold: traders say Emberhold had a wedding — or so the traders say
📡 The world feed: Thornfield — a harvest festival. The chat has opinions.
📨 Word came: Raj Patel of Stonebridge wants to join Haven. "Word travels: Haven takes people in. I'm people." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
The village debates Lena Ruiz. The room is cold — Omar, Ursula, Jorge against. "More mouths, same fire." (38% for.)
The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn hotter from here.)
That night, they bring Theo home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
⚠ WARNING: reserves critical. Eat tomorrow or the spiral begins.
Village meal: +2380 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry.
Someone is crying, quietly, in one of the bunks. Caleb goes to sit with them.
Jorge came back with 474 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 237 kcal in, 237 kcal eaten at the fire.
Caleb came back with 616 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 308 kcal in, 308 kcal eaten at the fire.

🍽️ Caleb taps the pantry door — full to bursting — and keeps the day's share in hand. "Dinner's on me tonight, then."

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/7/3), 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.

◈ THE WAR PATH — A moment of respect, from something that rarely respects. Even now the wave-4 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 1 veterans). Even now the wave-5 bar reads: blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans).
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
The deer. The cleanest kill. The table goes very still. Behind you, your own people go still too — a different stillness.
You let them see it. All of it. The table recalculates. The fire back home burns a little lower.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.
◈ THE FEARED — the last choice is yours, and it's live.
◈ THE FEARED — "Show mercy."

The most frightening thing you ever did. The table doesn't know what to do with mercy from a predator. Neither do you, quite. But the audience weeps, and the galaxy learns that the feared one chose gentleness — and that choice echoes longer than any threat. The terror stays, pledged now: a shield over every village, forever.
You learned to wait until a shot was worth taking. Sometimes that meant lowering the weapon.
The arrow left in your quiver mattered too. You had not spent every clean line of sight.

◈ Stan Kowalski walks out of the light alone, which is how he walked in — and the galaxy, which came to watch a monster, leaves afraid of the right things. The fear is a shield now, held over a village that trusts the hand that holds it.
◈ THE OVERSIGHT —
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
And somewhere out there — past the cameras, past the light — in rows of humming glass, the little ones are still napping.
The System put a pod on the screen, and you let the segment play.
They are still there. Still small. Still waiting for someone to decide they matter more than the moment.

That is what the word means. Not the watching — anyone can watch. The oversight is the looking away. The most terrible thing the System ever did, it did by accident, because it was bored. You did it on purpose, because you were busy.
The village will tell your story for years. It will be a good story. Listen for the part they don't tell.

💛 You hold Daughter's Drawing. Kitchen table, burnt pancakes. You told her the sun needed holding, and she took you literally — drew you carrying it with both hands. She was six. The sky changed three weeks later. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon.
